Name: Villager
description: A unit with no job yet. Uses the base sprite. Wanders, eats, sleeps and dreams of becoming something. When more than 5 jobless units are around, one may proclaim himself king.

Name: Farmer
description: Produces 15 points of food everyday, and stores it in the chest of the kingdom. People then come to the chest to eat. But before putting the food in the chest, they give the food to their family.

Name: Blacksmith
description: Builds structures, repairs structures when damaged. (This is the 'builder' mentioned in the Events pages.)

Name: Bard
description: Plays music around the kingdom and organizes theater plays together with another bard.

Name: Merchant
description: Travels between kingdoms and brings gold to the chest of the kingdom.

Name: Axeman
description: Gathers wood by cutting down trees and stores it in the chest of the kingdom. (Damage is a guess.)

Name: Hunter
description: Hunts the animals that appear across the map and brings the meat to the chest of the kingdom. NEEDS A SPRITE: for now it is the base sprite tinted green.

Name: Knight
description: They can attack close range. (Renamed from Swordsman.)

Name: Mage
description: Heals hurt, burned or poisoned units. Can also burn enemies with fire during a war.

Name: Witch
description: Only evil units want to be witches. Their attacks can poison.

Name: Joker
description: Sometimes joins the theater plays. Stays near the king and helps him make sure the kingdom is running well. Likes to hear about rumors and tells the king.

Name: Innkeeper
description: Stays next to the chest and serves food. Everyone who eats next to the innkeeper gets a bit more out of the meal and hears the latest rumors.

Name: King
description: The king from a kingdom is the one making the decisions in their kingdom, not their spouse. When he dies, the prince becomes the new king.

Name: Queen
description: Looks different, rules the same. Units are genderless, so a new ruler randomly looks like a king or a queen.

Name: Prince
description: The one inheriting the kingdom. When the king dies, the prince transforms into the new king.

Name: Princess
description: Looks different, inherits the same. A new heir randomly looks like a prince or a princess.
